xml_structure: <e-flexbox configuration-id="Map"><e-div-block configuration-id="Map pin halo"></e-div-block><e-div-block configuration-id="Map pin"></e-div-block><e-flexbox configuration-id="Location card"><e-flexbox configuration-id="Location label"><e-div-block configuration-id="Location rule"></e-div-block><e-paragraph configuration-id="Location eyebrow"></e-paragraph></e-flexbox><e-heading configuration-id="Location title"></e-heading><e-paragraph configuration-id="Location address"></e-paragraph><e-button configuration-id="Get directions"></e-button></e-flexbox></e-flexbox>

Location address.paragraph:
Office M-A98, Hamra Building
Karama, Dubai — United Arab Emirates

style.Map: position: relative; overflow: hidden; min-height: 560px; padding: 130px max(40px, calc((100% - 1350px) / 2)); align-items: center; background: linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(7,31,68,0.72) 0%, rgba(7,31,68,0.72) 100%), url(https://soharon.co.uk/onora/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/contact-map-plate.jpg) center / cover no-repeat, #071F44; @media(--tablet){ min-height: 480px; padding: 96px 40px; } @media(--mobile){ min-height: 0px; padding: 64px 20px 260px 20px; }
style.Map pin halo: position: absolute; top: 235px; right: 325px; width: 90px; height: 90px; min-width: 90px; padding: 0px; border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(226,187,108,0.18); @media(--tablet){ right: 85px; } @media(--mobile){ top: auto; bottom: 65px; right: 150px; }
style.Map pin: position: absolute; top: 266px; right: 356px; width: 28px; height: 28px; min-width: 28px; padding: 0px; border-radius: 50%; border: 5px solid #FFFFFF; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #A5740B 0%, #DEAF57 25%, #F1C96A 50%, #BE8826 75%, #A5740B 100%); @media(--tablet){ right: 116px; } @media(--mobile){ top: auto; bottom: 96px; right: 181px; }
style.Location card: position: relative; z-index: 2; flex-direction: column; gap: 18px; padding: 44px; width: 440px; max-width: 100%; background: #FFFFFF; align-items: flex-start; @media(--mobile){ padding: 32px 24px; }
style.Location label: padding: 0px; width: auto; gap: 14px; align-items: center;
style.Location rule: width: 32px; min-width: 32px; height: 2px; padding: 0px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #A5740B 0%, #DEAF57 25%, #F1C96A 50%, #BE8826 75%, #A5740B 100%);
style.Location eyebrow: font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 600; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 3px; text-transform: uppercase; color: #C9962E;
style.Location title: font-family: var(--on-serif); font-weight: 600; font-size: 36px; line-height: 37px; letter-spacing: -0.3px; color: #0B2F62; @media(--mobile){ font-size: 30px; line-height: 32px; }
style.Location address: font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 400; font-size: 15px; line-height: 26px; color: #5F6675;
style.Get directions: background: #0B2F62; color: #FFFFFF; font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 600; font-size: 12px; line-height: 18px; letter-spacing: 2.2px; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 18px 30px; border-radius: 0px; transition: background-color 0.3s; &:hover{ background: #071F44; }
